{{Quote|I had not thought humans capable of such tactical decisions.''"<br />"''<nowiki></nowiki>''[&hellip;]'' And that's exactly why we're stuck here like spine rats in a burrow.|[[Shawnkyr Nuruodo]] and Jagged Fel|<ref name="RSBF">{{GamerCite|7|Red Sky, Blue Flame}}</ref>}}
The '''spine rat''' was a creature known to the [[Empire of the Hand]]<ref name="RSBF" /> coalition.<ref name="Crisis of Faith>{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Red Sky, Blue Flame]]'' to [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].</ref> during a [[Battle of Rhigar|battle]] between the Empire of the Hand and the [[Cavrilhu Pirates]] on the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="RSBF" /> [[Rhigar/Legends|Rhigar]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the cadets of the [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo training academy]] hid in a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] within the academy as part of a sneak attack on the invading [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. While waiting for the invaders, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] cadet [[Jagged Fel]] compared the students of the Empire of the Hand academy's hiding to that of the spine rat's in a burrow.<ref name="RSBF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The spine rats were mentioned in the [[2001]] short story ''[[Red Sky, Blue Flame]]'', which was written by [[Elaine Cunningham]] and published within the [[Star Wars Gamer 7|seventh]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine.<ref name="RSBF" />
